rapport_notes: Patient and transparent with a very price-sensitive, skeptical customer who repeatedly pressed on the per-15-minute billing math.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked -- customer led with a direct pricing question and rep moved straight into quid pro quo ("let's get you quoted and yeah, let's start with a few questions... this should take about six to ten minutes") without the 'biggest concerns' line.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "at the end of the day, you will only be charged for the actual hours rendered"

top_strength: Patiently and transparently walked a skeptical, budget-conscious customer through exactly how the per-15-minute overage billing works, building trust with clear math.
coaching_note: Asking the 'biggest concerns' question up front would have surfaced the price sensitivity early, letting the rep address value (damage coverage, no hidden fees) before the customer got sticker shock near the end ('almost $700 for such a small move').
